limitations: The PRIDE API file list omits 13 RAW files that are on the FTP server (e.g. SP_120724_A1_2, T1_1); all 112 are annotated, completing 7 fractions for each of the 16 samples.

The paper says six HILIC fractions were collected, but every sample has seven RAW files (_1–_7); the file suffix is annotated as the fraction identifier. The _1 runs of 12 samples used a separate 'first' method (MS338_first_…).
The segment letter (A/T/D/S) and patient number are read from the file names; the deposit has no sample table.
Age and sex of the patients are not reported.
Membrane enrichment (sodium carbonate wash, ultracentrifugation) is described in the report only; no SDRF column.
